cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.description: Its six eggs use telepathy to communicate among themselves. It is believed to carry plant genes and the genes of other species.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.description: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.description: Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.

cards.name: Lickilicky
cards.description: Their saliva contains lots of components that can dissolve anything. The numbness caused by their lick does not dissipate.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.description: When it senses danger, it perks up its ears. On cold nights, it sleeps with its head tucked into its fur.

cards.name: Lopunny
cards.description: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.

cards.name: Glameow
cards.description: When it's happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

cards.name: Purugly
cards.description: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

cards.name: Cherrim
cards.description: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun's rays with its whole body.

cards.name: Fan Rotom
cards.description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.description: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Yungoos
cards.description: It wanders around in a never-ending search for food. At dusk, it collapses from exhaustion and falls asleep on the spot.

cards.name: Gumshoos
cards.description: It adores having Rattata and Raticate for dinner, but as it's diurnal, it never encounters them. This Pokémon boasts incredible patience.

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.description: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

cards.name: Type: Null
cards.description: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.description: This Pokémon is friendly to people and loves children most of all. It comes from deep in the mountains to play with children it likes in town.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.description: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

cards.name: Mow Rotom
cards.description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.description: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.description: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

cards.name: Araquanid
cards.description: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.description: When angered, it spouts brilliant fire from all over its body. It doesn't calm down until its opponent has burned to ash.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.description: From its arm, it launches fireballs hotter than 3,500 degrees Fahrenheit. Its arm starts to melt when it fires a whole barrage.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.description: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.description: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.description: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

cards.name: Monferno
cards.description: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

cards.name: Infernape
cards.description: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

cards.name: Heat Rotom
cards.description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.description: Volcanoes or dry, craggy places are its home. It emanates a sweet-smelling poisonous gas that attracts bug Pokémon, then attacks them.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.description: Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted to use in the production of luscious perfumes.

cards.name: Turtonator
cards.description: It gushes fire and poisonous gases from its nostrils. Its dung is an explosive substance and can be put to various uses.

cards.name: Alolan Sandshrew
cards.description: An ancient tradition of Alolan festivals, still carried on to this day, is a competition to slide Sandshrew across ice as far as one can.

cards.name: Alolan Sandslash
cards.description: This Pokémon's steel spikes are sheathed in ice. Stabs from these spikes cause deep wounds and severe frostbite as well.

cards.name: Yanmega
cards.description: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

cards.name: Alolan Vulpix
cards.description: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.description: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.description: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.description: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.description: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.description: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.

cards.name: Floatzel
cards.description: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.

cards.name: Snover
cards.description: In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.

cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.description: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

cards.name: Roselia
cards.description: Roselia that drink nutritionally rich springwater are said to reveal rare coloration when they bloom.

cards.name: Wash Rotom
cards.description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Frost Rotom
cards.description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.description: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.description: Electricity leaks from it in amounts far greater than the amount of electricity it eats.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.description: When it gets excited, it thumps its chest. With every thud, thunder roars and electric sparks shower all around.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.description: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.description: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

cards.name: Roserade
cards.description: With the movements of a dancer, it strikes with whips that are densely lined with poison thorns.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.description: If for some reason its body bursts, its soul spills out with a screaming sound.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.description: Even while under careful observation, large flocks of Drifblim flying at dusk will inexplicably disappear from view.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.description: It was bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

cards.name: Skorupi
cards.description: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

cards.name: Drapion
cards.description: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.description: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.description: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

cards.name: Giratina ◇
cards.description: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

cards.name: Cresselia
cards.description: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.description: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.description: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

cards.name: Cosmoem
cards.description: There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell. People think this Pokémon may come from another world.

cards.name: Lunala ◇
cards.description: Said to live in another world, this Pokémon devours light, drawing the moonless dark veil of night over the brightness of day.

cards.name: Cranidos
cards.description: In rock layers where Cranidos fossils are found, the fossilized trunks of trees snapped in two are also often found.

cards.name: Rampardos
cards.description: Records exist of a revived fossil that evolved into Rampardos. It proceeded to escape and then destroy a skyscraper with a headbutt.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: It's tough enough to run right through the night, and it's also a hard worker, but it's still just a youngster.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.description: They can detect the species of a living being—and its emotions—from over half a mile away. They control auras and hunt their prey in packs.

cards.name: Hippopotas
cards.description: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

cards.name: Hippowdon
cards.description: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.description: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

cards.name: Passimian
cards.description: They battle with hard berries for weapons. Their techniques are passed from the boss to the group, generation upon generation.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.description: Seen as a symbol of bad luck, it's generally disliked. Yet it gives presents—objects that sparkle or shine—to Trainers it's close to.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.description: If its Murkrow cronies fail to catch food for it, or if it feels they have betrayed it, it will hunt them down wherever they are and punish them.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.description: It uses its claws to poke holes in eggs so it can slurp out the insides. Breeders consider it a scourge and will drive it away or eradicate it.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.description: They dwell in cold places. This Pokémon's main food source in Alola is Vulpix and Sandshrew, which they carefully divide among their group.

cards.name: Stunky
cards.description: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

cards.name: Skuntank
cards.description: It sprays a stinky fluid from its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester.

cards.name: Darkrai ◇
cards.description: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

cards.name: Alolan Diglett
cards.description: Its golden hairs function as sensors. It pokes them out of its burrow to monitor its surroundings.

cards.name: Alolan Dugtrio
cards.description: These Pokémon are cherished in the Alola region, where they are thought to be feminine deities of the land incarnate.

cards.name: Grotle
cards.description: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.description: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.description: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.description: It has about three times the electrical power of Magnemite. For some reason, outbreaks of this Pokémon happen when lots of sunspots appear.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.description: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin, while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

cards.name: Shieldon
cards.description: This Pokémon lived in primeval jungles. Few enemies would have been willing to square off against its heavily armored face, so it's thought.

cards.name: Bastiodon
cards.description: It lived in the same environments as Rampardos. Their fossils have been found together—seemingly from after they'd fought to the finish.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.description: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.description: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

cards.name: Heatran
cards.description: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

cards.name: Solgaleo ◇
cards.description: This Pokémon is said to be a male evolution of Cosmog. At the activation of its third eye, it departs for another world.

cards.name: Torterra
cards.description: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

cards.name: Magearna
cards.description: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

cards.name: Morelull
cards.description: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

cards.name: Shiinotic
cards.description: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

cards.name: Tapu Lele
cards.description: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.

cards.name: Alolan Exeggutor
cards.description: Alola is the best environment for this Pokémon. Local people take pride in its appearance, saying this is how Exeggutor ought to look.

cards.name: Gible
cards.description: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

cards.name: Gible
cards.description: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.description: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.description: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.
